definition: מְסוּכָה noun feminine hedge (|| form of מְשֻׂכָה q. v. below שׂוך ); — only in figure יָשָׁר מִמְּסוּכָה Mic 7:4 , read ׳ יְשָׁרָם מְס (|| טוֺבָם כְּחֵדֶק ), their most upright one is a hedge (an obstruction).

מְסוּכָה noun feminine hedge (|| form of מְשֻׂכָה q. v. below שׂוך); — only in figure יָשָׁר מִמְּסוּכָה Mic 7:4, read ׳יְשָׁרָם מְס (|| טוֺבָם כְּחֵדֶק), their most upright one is a hedge (an obstruction).
